summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  **What I found (read-only audit, no changes made):**  I had an agent trace the full chain — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → auth middleware → `modules/watchlist` → DB — and each link works correctly in isolation: - The client doesn't use localStorage/anonymous fallback for watchlist data; it always re-fetches from the API on mount, with `credentials: "include"` so cookies flow properly. - The watchlist middleware correctly rejects unauthenticated requests and injects `X-User-Id` from the session. - `modules/watchlist` filters eve
